funding_method: settled realizedRate, constant-notional scenario; excluded entirely for symbols without full coverage
history_quality_note: Trailing window is bounded to improve settlement coverage; shortening data reduces regime diversity, not proof of edge. Raw caches retain their longer auditable histories.
hypothesis_selection_policy: First 2000 IDs unchanged; four additional deterministic families historical-only; family-diverse training-only fold nominations; shadow evaluations of failed training variants NEVER promoted; not an independent alpha test
limitations: All signals use the last confirmed candle and hypothetical next-bar OPEN.
Historical OHLCV trading is not an executed or forward paper trade.
No actual fills, exchange liquidation or true slippage are simulated.
Settled historical funding is a constant-notional sensitivity only where coverage is complete.
Intrabar high/low margin proxy does not confirm real liquidation, margin tier or path.
0.10% roundtrip fees plus 0.12% additional hypothetical friction.
An extra predeclared 0.25% roundtrip impact is stress-tested on UTC day clusters; no actual fill data.
Shadow evaluations for training-rejected hypotheses are exploratory, not formal candidate selection.
Both ordinary and shadow walk-forward validation are REPEATEDLY inspected, not an untouched final holdout.
Purge between training and validation; validation is REPEATEDLY observed.
2400 exploratory parameter variants expand multiplicity; no family-wise alpha correction or tradable-edge claim.
Multiple-parameter testing and correlated assets inflate apparent winners.
A frozen untouched future dataset and prospective paper trials are REQUIRED.
research_recommendation: Continue prospective v8 paper trades separately; historical candidates require versioned, independent forward validation before any promotion.
shadow_diagnostic_policy: At most four disqualified training-only hypotheses per fold evaluated chronologically as descriptive shadow research; NOT promoted
simulation_accounting_note: Overlapping hypothetical historical trades across correlated variants are NOT independent observations, forward paper fills, or evidence of a profitable trading strategy.
training_selection_policy: first-best-per-family from TRAIN rankings, then fill; no validation feedback
window_policy: trailing common confirmed 15m candles; funding never zero-filled
